cohort: This study included 1000 deliveries after 28 weeks' gestation.
finding: Blood loss, febrile morbidity, and surgical site infection were higher in cesarean sections compared to vaginal deliveries, and neonatal outcomes were relatively worse in cesarean sections compared to vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Blood loss, febrile morbidity, and surgical site infection were higher in cesarean sections compared to vaginal deliveries, and neonatal outcomes were relatively worse in cesarean sections.
